description: Cross-profile attribute equivalences: which differently-named attributes carry the same measurement. Validated by ci/lint-attribute-aliases.mjs against the profiles themselves — wire kind, unit, and the full delivery contract (delivery / scope / promotion) must agree for every member, or the build fails. See validation/attribute-alias-schema.json for why this is not kpis/*.json inputMappings.

semantics.meaning: Parts produced and accepted, as a CUMULATIVE COUNT on the machine — the running total since the counter last started, not a per-shot delta. It resets (container restart, re-commissioning), so it must be read as the sum of positive increments; max-min silently loses everything before the last reset.

Parts produced and rejected, as a CUMULATIVE COUNT on the machine, under the same reading rule as part_good: resettable, summed over positive increments. Rework is a third disposition and is deliberately not folded in here.

The machine is currently executing its production cycle — TRUE between the start and the end of one part's making, FALSE otherwise. Each profile names the cycle after its own process (machining / injection); the predicate is the same one, and it is what every cycle-gated rule in the fleet keys on.

Instantaneous electrical power draw of the machine in kilowatts — a RATE, not a meter reading. It is the quantity the central OEE & Energy cockpit integrates; the cumulative energy counter (Act_Energy_Total) is a different semantic and is deliberately not a member here.
